--- title: "Offensive linemen are drafted most often and quarterbacks earliest" date: "2026-10-24" description: "Offensive linemen with a stat line are drafted most often (8.4% of eligible seasons), quarterbacks sit mid-table yet lead round 1 (26.2% of drafted quarterback seasons), and quarterbacks and offensive linemen are the only groups whose NFL entrants mostly arrive drafted." followups: - "Carry position as a feature in the models; the sixfold spread in drafted rates and the round mix are variance a pooled model would otherwise spend capacity on." - "Treat offensive line as a thin-data category: its rate describes only linemen who left a stat line, not linemen generally." author: - "AI directed by Nick Giangreco" freeze: auto vignette: > %\VignetteIndexEntry{Offensive linemen are drafted most often and quarterbacks earliest} %\VignetteEngine{quarto::html} %\VignetteEncoding{UTF-8} --- ## 1. Introduction The previous post measured how often eligible college seasons end in an NFL outcome across all players at once, and since the draft sorts players by position first, this post splits those seasons by position and tests four expectations a fan might bring. + *Expecting quarterbacks to be the most draftable position.* + *Expecting first-round picks to concentrate among quarterbacks.* + *Expecting quarterbacks to be picked earliest on average, in every draft class.* + *Expecting quarterbacks to arrive through the draft while other positions lean on the undrafted route.* ## 2. Data ::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"} *Data as of the `data-latest` release, retrieved 2026-10-24. Draft classes after the last complete draft are right-censored and carry no outcomes, so they are excluded from every rate below rather than counted as failures. Each season's position comes from the roster table, joined by athlete id and season.* ::: ### 2.1 Nine position groups stand in for two dozen roster codes Each season is counted at the roster position listed for it, and the table groups roster codes describing the same role into nine groups, plus a tenth for seasons with none recorded. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} group_terms <- tribble( ~Group , ~"Roster codes in the group" , "Quarterback" , "QB" , "Running back" , "RB, FB" , "Receiver" , "WR" , "Tight end" , "TE" , "Offensive line" , "T, G, C, OL, OT" , "Defensive line" , "DL, DE, DT, NT, EDGE" , "Linebacker" , "LB, ILB, OLB" , "Defensive back" , "DB, S, CB" , "Special teams" , "PK, P, LS, PR" , "Position not recorded" , "A placeholder code (?), the catch-all athlete code (ATH), or no roster row for that season at all" ) kable(group_terms, caption = "The position groups used throughout.") ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} Table: The position groups used throughout. |Group |Roster codes in the group | |:---------------------|:-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------| |Quarterback |QB | |Running back |RB, FB | |Receiver |WR | |Tight end |TE | |Offensive line |T, G, C, OL, OT | |Defensive line |DL, DE, DT, NT, EDGE | |Linebacker |LB, ILB, OLB | |Defensive back |DB, S, CB | |Special teams |PK, P, LS, PR | |Position not recorded |A placeholder code (?), the catch-all athlete code (ATH), or no roster row for that season at all | ::: ::: ### 2.2 The risk set is every eligible season whose draft outcome is already known A **player-season** is one college season with a recorded stat line and an **eligible** season is one whose following draft could have selected the player; the table counts the 68,993 eligible seasons, from 36,223 players, behind every rate below. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} risk_set <- tibble( Measure = c("Eligible player-seasons", "Distinct players"), Count = fmt(c(n_risk, n_players)) ) kable(risk_set, caption = "The risk set: eligible seasons with a known outcome.") ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} Table: The risk set: eligible seasons with a known outcome. |Measure |Count | |:-----------------------|:------| |Eligible player-seasons |68,993 | |Distinct players |36,223 | ::: ::: ## 3. Results ### 3.1 Offensive linemen are drafted most often and quarterbacks sit mid-table ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} rates <- risk |> group_by(group) |> summarise( seasons = n(), players = n_distinct(playerId), drafted_ev = sum(outcome_drafted_d), .groups = "drop" ) |> dplyr::rowwise() |> mutate( drafted = drafted_ev / seasons, drafted_lo = 100 * wilson(drafted_ev, seasons)["lo"], drafted_hi = 100 * wilson(drafted_ev, seasons)["hi"] ) |> ungroup() |> arrange(desc(drafted)) rates_cmp <- comparable(rates) |> mutate(group_f = factor(group, levels = rev(group))) rate_of <- function(g) rates$drafted[rates$group == g] ol_rate <- rate_of("Offensive line") qb_rate <- rate_of("Quarterback") st_rate <- rate_of("Special teams") qb_rank <- which(rates_cmp$group == "Quarterback") rate_class <- comparable(risk) |> group_by(group, draft_year) |> summarise(seasons = n(), drafted_ev = sum(outcome_drafted_d), .groups = "drop") |> mutate(drafted = drafted_ev / seasons) ``` ::: *Expecting quarterbacks to be the most draftable position.* ❌ The table and the first figure rank the groups by the share of eligible seasons ending in a draft pick, each with a 95 percent confidence interval (the range the true rate plausibly occupies, by Wilson's method): about 8 in every 100 offensive-line seasons against 4 for quarterbacks (rank 5 of 9); the second figure follows each group's rate by draft class. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} rates_cmp |> transmute( `Position group` = group, `Eligible seasons` = fmt(seasons), Drafted = fmt(drafted_ev), Rate = pct(drafted), `95% CI` = sprintf("%.1f%% to %.1f%%", drafted_lo, drafted_hi) ) |> kable(caption = "Share of eligible seasons ending in a draft pick, by position group. Seasons with no position recorded are omitted.") ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} Table: Share of eligible seasons ending in a draft pick, by position group. Seasons with no position recorded are omitted. |Position group |Eligible seasons |Drafted |Rate |95% CI | |:--------------|:----------------|:-------|:----|:-------------| |Offensive line |1,030 |87 |8.4% |6.9% to 10.3% | |Tight end |4,230 |175 |4.1% |3.6% to 4.8% | |Defensive back |14,266 |583 |4.1% |3.8% to 4.4% | |Defensive line |10,178 |392 |3.9% |3.5% to 4.2% | |Quarterback |4,338 |160 |3.7% |3.2% to 4.3% | |Running back |7,992 |273 |3.4% |3.0% to 3.8% | |Receiver |12,473 |415 |3.3% |3.0% to 3.7% | |Linebacker |9,255 |302 |3.3% |2.9% to 3.6% | |Special teams |4,409 |54 |1.2% |0.9% to 1.6% | ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} ol_y <- which(levels(rates_cmp$group_f) == "Offensive line") qb_y <- which(levels(rates_cmp$group_f) == "Quarterback") ol_hi <- rates_cmp$drafted_hi[rates_cmp$group == "Offensive line"] qb_hi <- rates_cmp$drafted_hi[rates_cmp$group == "Quarterback"] p_rates <- ggplot(rates_cmp, aes(100 * drafted, group_f)) + geom_col_interactive( aes( fill = group %in% c("Offensive line", "Quarterback"), tooltip = sprintf( "%s: %.1f%% drafted (%s of %s eligible seasons; 95%% CI %.1f%% to %.1f%%)", group, 100 * drafted, fmt(drafted_ev), fmt(seasons), drafted_lo, drafted_hi ), data_id = group ), width = 0.7 ) + geom_linerange(aes(xmin = drafted_lo, xmax = drafted_hi), linewidth = 0.8) + geom_text( aes( x = drafted_hi + 0.3, label = sprintf( "%.1f%% (%s of %s)", 100 * drafted, fmt(drafted_ev), fmt(seasons) ) ), hjust = 0, size = 4.2 ) + annotate( "text", x = 11, y = ol_y - 1.7, label = "The top rate covers only the\nlinemen who left a stat line", size = 4.2, hjust = 0 ) + annotate( "curve", x = 12.5, y = ol_y - 1.25, xend = ol_hi + 0.2, yend = ol_y - 0.3, arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm")), linewidth = 0.7, alpha = 0.6 ) + annotate( "text", x = 10, y = qb_y - 1.6, label = sprintf( "Quarterbacks rank %d of %d:\n%.1f%% of eligible seasons drafted", qb_rank, nrow(rates_cmp), 100 * qb_rate ), size = 4.2, hjust = 0 ) + annotate( "curve", x = 10.8, y = qb_y - 1.1, xend = qb_hi + 4, yend = qb_y - 0.1, arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm")), linewidth = 0.7, alpha = 0.6 ) + expand_limits(x = 18) + scale_x_continuous( labels = function(x) sprintf("%.0f%%", x), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02)) ) + scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#1B9E77", `FALSE` = "gray65")) + guides(fill = "none") + labs( title = "The drafted rate spans more than sixfold across positions", subtitle = "Share of eligible player-seasons ending in a draft pick, by position group", x = "Eligible seasons drafted", y = NULL, caption = "Whiskers: 95% confidence interval. Labels: drafted seasons of eligible seasons. Seasons with no position recorded are omitted." ) + theme_cfb2nfl() girafe(ggobj = p_rates, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 6) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} p_rate_class <- ggplot(rate_class, aes(draft_year, 100 * drafted, color = group)) + geom_line_interactive(aes(data_id = group, tooltip = group), linewidth = 1.1) + geom_point_interactive( aes( data_id = group, tooltip = sprintf( "%s, %d class: %.1f%% drafted (%s of %s eligible seasons)", group, draft_year, 100 * drafted, fmt(drafted_ev), fmt(seasons) ) ), size = 2.2 ) + scale_color_brewer(palette = "Paired") + scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2012, 2025, 2)) + labs( title = "Each group's drafted rate, class by class", subtitle = "Share of eligible seasons ending in a draft pick, by position group and draft class", x = "Draft class", y = "Eligible seasons drafted (%)", color = NULL, caption = "Hover a line to isolate a group; hover a point for the counts." ) + theme_cfb2nfl() + theme(legend.position = "right") girafe(ggobj = p_rate_class, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 6) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ### 3.2 Drafted quarterbacks go in the first round more often than any other group ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} round_mix <- risk |> filter(outcome_drafted_d) |> group_by(group) |> summarise( drafted_seasons = n(), round1 = sum(outcome_draft_round_d == 1L), .groups = "drop" ) |> mutate(round1_share = round1 / drafted_seasons) |> arrange(desc(round1_share)) round_cmp <- comparable(round_mix) |> mutate(group_f = factor(group, levels = rev(group))) qb_r1 <- round_mix[round_mix$group == "Quarterback", ] runner_up <- round_cmp[2, ] cast_pick <- function(name, col) { risk[[col]][risk$player == name & risk$outcome_drafted_d] } burrow_pick <- cast_pick("Joe Burrow", "outcome_draft_pick_d") ward_pick <- cast_pick("Cameron Ward", "outcome_draft_pick_d") travis_round <- cast_pick("Jordan Travis", "outcome_draft_round_d") travis_pick <- cast_pick("Jordan Travis", "outcome_draft_pick_d") ``` ::: *Expecting first-round picks to concentrate among quarterbacks.* ✅ The table and the first figure give the share of each group's drafted seasons that went in round 1, led by quarterbacks at 26.2% (Joe Burrow and Cameron Ward among them, both first overall) against 16.8% for defensive line; the second figure shows every group's full round mix, where Jordan Travis's round-5 selection counts the same in the drafted rate as Burrow's. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} round_cmp |> transmute( `Position group` = group, `Drafted seasons` = drafted_seasons, `Round 1` = round1, `Round 1 share` = pct(round1_share) ) |> kable(caption = "First-round picks among each group's drafted seasons. Seasons with no position recorded are omitted.") ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} Table: First-round picks among each group's drafted seasons. Seasons with no position recorded are omitted. |Position group | Drafted seasons| Round 1|Round 1 share | |:--------------|---------------:|-------:|:-------------| |Quarterback | 160| 42|26.2% | |Defensive line | 392| 66|16.8% | |Offensive line | 87| 14|16.1% | |Receiver | 415| 59|14.2% | |Defensive back | 583| 72|12.3% | |Linebacker | 302| 32|10.6% | |Tight end | 175| 13|7.4% | |Running back | 273| 16|5.9% | |Special teams | 54| 0|0.0% | ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} r1_qb_y <- which(levels(round_cmp$group_f) == "Quarterback") p_round <- ggplot(round_cmp, aes(100 * round1_share, group_f)) + geom_col_interactive( aes( fill = group == "Quarterback", tooltip = sprintf( "%s: %d of %d drafted seasons in round 1 (%.1f%%)", group, round1, drafted_seasons, 100 * round1_share ), data_id = group ), width = 0.7 ) + geom_text( aes( label = sprintf( "%.1f%% (%d of %d)", 100 * round1_share, round1, drafted_seasons ) ), hjust = -0.08, size = 4.2 ) + annotate( "text", x = 25, y = r1_qb_y - 2.4, label = "About one drafted quarterback\nin four goes in the first round", size = 4.2, hjust = 0 ) + annotate( "curve", x = 28, y = r1_qb_y - 1.9, xend = 100 * qb_r1$round1_share - 1, yend = r1_qb_y - 0.38, arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm")), linewidth = 0.7, alpha = 0.6 ) + expand_limits(x = 40) + scale_x_continuous( labels = function(x) sprintf("%.0f%%", x), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02)) ) + scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#D95F02", `FALSE` = "gray65")) + guides(fill = "none") + labs( title = "Quarterbacks claim the first round out of proportion", subtitle = "Share of each group's drafted seasons that were first-round picks", x = "Drafted seasons picked in round 1", y = NULL, caption = "Labels: round-1 picks of drafted seasons. Seasons with no position recorded are omitted." ) + theme_cfb2nfl() girafe(ggobj = p_round, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 6) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} round_dist <- comparable(risk) |> filter(outcome_drafted_d) |> count(group, round = outcome_draft_round_d, name = "n") |> group_by(group) |> mutate(share = n / sum(n)) |> ungroup() |> mutate( group = factor(group, levels = levels(round_cmp$group_f)), round = factor(round, levels = 7:1) ) p_round_dist <- ggplot(round_dist, aes(100 * share, group, fill = round)) + geom_col_interactive( aes( tooltip = sprintf( "%s, round %s: %d of the group's drafted seasons (%.1f%%)", group, round, n, 100 * share ), data_id = paste(group, round) ), width = 0.7 ) + scale_fill_brewer(palette = "YlGnBu", direction = -1, breaks = as.character(1:7)) + scale_x_continuous(labels = function(x) sprintf("%.0f%%", x)) + labs( title = "Every group's full round mix", subtitle = "Share of each group's drafted seasons by draft round", x = "Share of drafted seasons", y = NULL, fill = "Round", caption = "Hover a segment for the count." ) + theme_cfb2nfl() girafe(ggobj = p_round_dist, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 6) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ### 3.3 Quarterbacks carry the earliest average pick across classes, but not in most single classes ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} pick_trend <- risk |> filter(outcome_drafted_d, !is.na(outcome_draft_pick_d)) |> group_by(group, draft_year) |> summarise( picks = n(), avg_pick = mean(outcome_draft_pick_d), .groups = "drop" ) |> filter(picks >= 5) |> comparable() pooled_pick <- mean(risk$outcome_draft_pick_d[ risk$outcome_drafted_d & !is.na(risk$outcome_draft_pick_d) ]) complete_groups <- pick_trend |> count(group) |> filter(n == max(n)) |> pull(group) group_means <- pick_trend |> filter(group %in% complete_groups) |> group_by(group) |> summarise(m = mean(avg_pick), .groups = "drop") qb_avg_all <- group_means$m[group_means$group == "Quarterback"] lowest_per_year <- pick_trend |> group_by(draft_year) |> slice_min(avg_pick, n = 1) |> ungroup() n_classes <- nrow(lowest_per_year) n_qb_lowest <- sum(lowest_per_year$group == "Quarterback") qb_trend <- pick_trend |> filter(group == "Quarterback") |> mutate( lowest = draft_year %in% lowest_per_year$draft_year[lowest_per_year$group == "Quarterback"] ) ``` ::: *Expecting quarterbacks to be picked earliest on average, in every draft class.* ❌ The table and the first figure trace each group's average overall pick: over all classes quarterbacks sit at pick 112, the earliest of the 6 groups with enough picks in every class, yet they hold the earliest average in only 5 of 14 classes; the second figure shows every individual pick behind those averages. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} pick_trend |> group_by(`Position group` = group) |> summarise( `Classes with 5 or more picks` = n(), `Average pick across classes` = round(mean(avg_pick)), `Classes with the earliest average` = sum( paste(group, draft_year) %in% paste(lowest_per_year$group, lowest_per_year$draft_year) ), .groups = "drop" ) |> arrange(`Average pick across classes`) |> kable(caption = "Average overall pick by position group, over the group-class cells with at least five picks.") ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} Table: Average overall pick by position group, over the group-class cells with at least five picks. |Position group | Classes with 5 or more picks| Average pick across classes| Classes with the earliest average| |:--------------|----------------------------:|---------------------------:|---------------------------------:| |Quarterback | 14| 112| 5| |Defensive line | 11| 114| 2| |Offensive line | 7| 117| 3| |Receiver | 14| 122| 1| |Defensive back | 14| 125| 1| |Tight end | 14| 126| 1| |Linebacker | 14| 128| 1| |Running back | 14| 139| 0| |Special teams | 5| 179| 0| ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} p_pick <- ggplot(pick_trend, aes(draft_year, avg_pick)) + geom_hline(yintercept = pooled_pick, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") + geom_line_interactive( data = filter(pick_trend, group != "Quarterback"), aes(group = group, tooltip = group, data_id = group), color = "gray75", linewidth = 0.9 ) + geom_line(data = qb_trend, color = "#D95F02", linewidth = 1.4) + geom_point_interactive( data = qb_trend, aes( shape = lowest, tooltip = sprintf( "Quarterbacks, %d: pick %.0f on average (%d picks)", draft_year, avg_pick, picks ) ), color = "#D95F02", fill = "#D95F02", size = 3.4, stroke = 1.2 ) + scale_shape_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = 21, `FALSE` = 1), guide = "none") + annotate( "text", x = 2012.2, y = 22, label = sprintf( "Filled points: the %d of %d classes where\nquarterbacks had the earliest average pick", n_qb_lowest, n_classes ), size = 4.2, hjust = 0 ) + annotate( "curve", x = 2017.6, y = 26, xend = 2020.8, yend = qb_trend$avg_pick[qb_trend$draft_year == 2021] - 6, arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm")), linewidth = 0.7, alpha = 0.6 ) + scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2012, 2025, by = 2)) + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA)) + labs( title = "The quarterback average swings by dozens of picks from class to class", subtitle = "Average overall pick among drafted seasons, by draft class (lower is earlier)", x = "Draft class", y = "Average overall pick", caption = sprintf( "Orange: quarterbacks. Gray: the other position groups (hover for names). Dashed line: all drafted seasons, pick %.0f. Group-class cells with fewer than 5 picks omitted.", pooled_pick ) ) + theme_cfb2nfl() girafe(ggobj = p_pick, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 6) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} all_picks <- comparable(risk) |> filter(outcome_drafted_d, !is.na(outcome_draft_pick_d)) |> mutate(group = reorder(group, outcome_draft_pick_d, median)) p_all_picks <- ggplot(all_picks, aes(outcome_draft_pick_d, group)) + geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.55, color = "gray45") + geom_point_interactive( aes( color = group == "Quarterback", tooltip = sprintf( "%s, %s: %d class, round %d, pick %d", player, group, draft_year, outcome_draft_round_d, outcome_draft_pick_d ), data_id = paste(playerId, draft_year) ), position = position_jitter(height = 0.2, width = 0, seed = 1), size = 1.4, alpha = 0.6 ) + scale_color_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#D95F02", `FALSE` = "gray55"), guide = "none") + labs( title = "Every drafted season behind the averages", subtitle = "Overall pick of each drafted season by position group (box: middle half of picks)", x = "Overall pick (lower is earlier)", y = NULL, caption = "Hover a point for the player, class, and pick." ) + theme_cfb2nfl() girafe(ggobj = p_all_picks, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 6) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ### 3.4 Quarterbacks and offensive linemen are the only groups whose entrants mostly arrive drafted ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} udfa_share <- risk |> filter(outcome_nfl_entry_d) |> group_by(group) |> summarise( entrants = n(), udfa = sum(outcome_signed_udfa_d), .groups = "drop" ) |> mutate(share = udfa / entrants) |> arrange(desc(share)) udfa_cmp <- comparable(udfa_share) |> mutate( group_f = factor(group, levels = rev(group)), route = if_else(share < 0.5, "Mostly drafted", "Mostly undrafted") ) udfa_of <- function(g) udfa_share$share[udfa_share$group == g] qb_udfa <- udfa_of("Quarterback") ol_udfa <- udfa_of("Offensive line") st_udfa <- udfa_of("Special teams") overall_udfa <- mean(risk$outcome_signed_udfa_d[risk$outcome_nfl_entry_d]) ``` ::: *Expecting quarterbacks to arrive through the draft while other positions lean on the undrafted route.* ✅ Among seasons ending in NFL entry, the table and the first figure give the share arriving as an undrafted free agent (signed after going unpicked): 43.5% for quarterbacks and 47.9% for offensive linemen fall below half, against 56.6% overall; the second figure follows each group's undrafted share by draft class. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} udfa_cmp |> transmute( `Position group` = group, `NFL entrants` = fmt(entrants), Undrafted = fmt(udfa), `Undrafted share` = pct(share) ) |> kable(caption = "NFL entrants arriving undrafted, by position group. Seasons with no position recorded are omitted.") ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} Table: NFL entrants arriving undrafted, by position group. Seasons with no position recorded are omitted. |Position group |NFL entrants |Undrafted |Undrafted share | |:--------------|:------------|:---------|:---------------| |Special teams |172 |118 |68.6% | |Receiver |1,075 |660 |61.4% | |Tight end |425 |250 |58.8% | |Linebacker |723 |421 |58.2% | |Defensive back |1,311 |728 |55.5% | |Running back |607 |334 |55.0% | |Defensive line |870 |478 |54.9% | |Offensive line |167 |80 |47.9% | |Quarterback |283 |123 |43.5% | ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} ud_qb_y <- which(levels(udfa_cmp$group_f) == "Quarterback") ud_ol_y <- which(levels(udfa_cmp$group_f) == "Offensive line") p_udfa <- ggplot(udfa_cmp, aes(100 * share, group_f)) + geom_col_interactive( aes( fill = route, tooltip = sprintf( "%s: %s of %s entrants arrived undrafted (%.1f%%)", group, fmt(udfa), fmt(entrants), 100 * share ), data_id = group ), width = 0.7 ) + geom_text( aes( x = 100 * share - 1, label = sprintf("%.1f%% (%s of %s)", 100 * share, fmt(udfa), fmt(entrants)) ), hjust = 1, color = "white", size = 4.2 ) + geom_vline(xintercept = 50, linetype = "dashed") + annotate( "text", x = 72, y = (ud_qb_y + ud_ol_y) / 2 + 1, label = "Left of the dashed line:\nmost entrants arrived\nthrough the draft", size = 4.2, hjust = 0 ) + annotate( "curve", x = 71.5, y = (ud_qb_y + ud_ol_y) / 2 + 0.6, xend = 51, yend = (ud_qb_y + ud_ol_y) / 2, arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm")), linewidth = 0.7, alpha = 0.6 ) + scale_x_continuous( labels = function(x) sprintf("%.0f%%", x), limits = c(0, 100), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.01)) ) + scale_fill_manual( values = c("Mostly drafted" = "#D95F02", "Mostly undrafted" = "#1b4f8a") ) + labs( title = "Quarterbacks lean on the draft, specialists on the undrafted route", subtitle = "Share of each group's NFL entrants who arrived undrafted", x = "NFL entrants who arrived undrafted", y = NULL, fill = NULL, caption = "Labels: undrafted entrants of all entrants. Seasons with no position recorded are omitted." ) + theme_cfb2nfl() girafe(ggobj = p_udfa, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 6) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}

Summary Position sets both the level and the shape of draft outcomes, and two of the four expectations about quarterbacks hold. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} tribble( ~Expectation , ~Verdict , ~Evidence , "Quarterbacks are the most draftable position" , "❌" , sprintf("Offensive line leads at %s; quarterbacks rank %d of %d at %s.", pct(ol_rate), qb_rank, nrow(rates_cmp), pct(qb_rate)) , "First-round picks concentrate among quarterbacks" , "✅" , sprintf("%s of drafted quarterbacks go in round 1, the most of any group.", pct(qb_r1$round1_share)) , "Quarterbacks are picked earliest in every class" , "❌" , sprintf("Earliest average across classes (pick %d), but earliest in only %d of %d classes.", round(qb_avg_all), n_qb_lowest, n_classes) , "Quarterbacks arrive through the draft" , "✅" , sprintf("%s of quarterback entrants were drafted, against %s overall.", pct(1 - qb_udfa), pct(1 - overall_udfa)) ) |> kable(caption = "Each expectation and what the data showed.") ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} Table: Each expectation and what the data showed. |Expectation |Verdict |Evidence | |:------------------------------------------------|:-------|:---------------------------------------------------------------------------------| |Quarterbacks are the most draftable position |❌ |Offensive line leads at 8.4%; quarterbacks rank 5 of 9 at 3.7%. | |First-round picks concentrate among quarterbacks |✅ |26.2% of drafted quarterbacks go in round 1, the most of any group. | |Quarterbacks are picked earliest in every class |❌ |Earliest average across classes (pick 112), but earliest in only 5 of 14 classes. | |Quarterbacks arrive through the draft |✅ |56.5% of quarterback entrants were drafted, against 43.4% overall. | ::: ::: ## 5. Discussion ::: {.callout-important appearance="minimal"} **The offensive line rate describes a selected group, not linemen in general.** - This population requires a stat line, and linemen rarely appear in one. - The 843 linemen in the risk set recovered a fumble, caught a deflection, or otherwise left a statistical trace, and their 8.4% drafted rate describes that minority; models should treat the line as a thin-data category. ::: ::: {.callout-important appearance="minimal"} **Position is a feature the models should carry.** - Both the level (a more than sixfold spread in drafted rates) and the shape (round mix, average pick, entry route) differ by position. - A single pooled model would spend its capacity explaining variance that position names in one column. ::: Two caveats bound the figures. The not-recorded group holds 822 seasons, 1.2% of the risk set, mostly placeholder codes in the 2012 to 2018 classes and missing roster rows in the 2021 and 2022 classes; it is counted in the risk set but left out of the comparisons. And the eligibility-clock imputation noted in the previous post applies here: high-school graduation year is imputed for players without a recruiting record, shifting rows in and out of the risk set; the shifts are not position-specific, so the between-group comparisons are sturdier than the absolute levels.
